newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC says to redeem pfd shares, debentures.
newsitem.headline: CIBC says to redeem pfd shares, debentures.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Thursday it will redeem two issues of preferred shares and one issue of debentures.
Both issues of preferred shares will be redeemed on December 2, with accrued dividends paid to that date, the bank said in a statement.
The redemption price for class A preferred shares series 11 will be C$26.75 per share, with a dividend of C$0.19344.
The price for the series 10 will be US$26.75 per share, with a dividend of US$0.16612.
CIBC's 9.4 percent debentures due December 3, 2001 will be redeemed on November 5 at par plus accrued interest.
The bank said formal notices of redemption will be mailed to holders of these shares and debentures.
